title: fix(metadata-protocol): a bare save of a name an enabled and a disabled package hold writes the enabled holder's row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #32605

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个名字同时被启用包 E 和停用包 D 持有时，不带包名的保存现在写 E 的行（和不带包名的读取落在同一处）。不再写无归属行，不再改 D 的行，也不再报出 D 的名字。
- 为什么改：以前读取答的是 E，保存却落到别处：要么写出一个以后会遮住两个包的"环境自有"行，要么悄悄改了停用包的行，下次读取还看不到改动。
- 风险与回滚：只在环境里有停用包、且它和启用包持有同一个名字时生效，第一方应用里 0 处。原来两行并存时的 409 变成写入 E 的行（放宽，已声明）。回滚就是撤掉这个 PR，存储的数据不需要迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` 文件末尾的 `servedPackagelessSaveAddress`，以及保存门里调用它的那段（不带包名的发布态保存）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts -t 32605`，预期 48 个用例全部通过（两种传输 × 两种注册顺序）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The epic ruling 6781691009 on #32354 decides this card: "a write resolves its address exactly as the read at the same address resolves it (D3/D5 symmetry)". It also says: "A bare save of that name is therefore E's write. It is E's customization (D4: a package-less save under a name one package holds is that holder's), it is bound to E, and it never touches D's row."

`saveMetaItemUnaudited` resolves the address of a publish-mode save that names no package. That step now asks a new module helper, `servedPackagelessSaveAddress`, in `protocol-save.ts`, before it falls back to `packagelessAddress` as before:

1. **The read's own judgment.** The helper first asks `servedAddressJudgment`, the one judgment the bare reads use since #32183 and #32354. The import is unchanged. When that judgment names a served holder, the save writes there. When it refuses because two or more holders are served, the save refuses too, with the save door's own 409 sentence, naming only the served holders.
2. **The row-only gap.** Some names a disabled package holds only as a stored row, while an enabled package ships them. The read judgment leaves that case to the read's content rule. If a disabled package is among the stored rows' bindings, the address is judged over the enabled bindings. One enabled binding is the address. Two or more are refused, naming them. If none is left, the address is the package-unbound row when one is stored (the row the read serves), otherwise the one enabled package that ships the name.
3. Otherwise nothing changes. That covers a name no disabled package holds, and a name only disabled packages hold.

`protocol.ts`, `registry-question.ts`, `seed-loader.ts` and `protocol-meta-item-face.ts` are not edited.

| bare save, name held by enabled E and disabled D | FROM (main 1e65a389) | TO |
|---|---|---|
| both ship it, no stored row | package-unbound row written (200) | row bound to E written (200) |
| both ship it, D's row only | D's row updated (200); next read still E's code | E's row written; D's row byte-unchanged |
| both ship it, a row of each | 409 naming E and D | E's row updated (widening); D's unchanged |
| two authored row holders E, D | 409 naming E and D | E's row updated (widening); D's unchanged |
| E ships it, authored D holds a row | D's row updated; read serves E | E's row written; D's unchanged |
| E ships it, package-unbound row plus D's row | D's row updated; read serves the unbound row | the unbound row updated; D's unchanged |
| three row holders, D disabled | 409 naming E, F and D | 409 naming E and F only |
| D enabled again (after the save) | 409 naming both | unchanged: read and save 409 naming both |
| CONTROL: a name only E ships, an unrelated package disabled | package-unbound overlay row | unchanged |
| CONTROL: a name only D holds (its row alone) | D's row updated | unchanged (see open question in the report) |

## Tests

The new top-level `describe('[#32605] …')` goes into the shared harness `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` (ruling record 6583487846). It boots a real kernel (registry, metadata service, `sys_metadata` on SQLite) and drives `PUT /meta/dashboard/:name` with no package. It runs on both transports, the runtime `HttpDispatcher` and `RestServer`'s `PUT` route, in both registration orders, with save orders where two rows are stored. That is 12 cases × 4 = 48. Each case asserts the stored rows by binding, byte-identity of D's row, the next bare read, and the 409 naming both once D is re-enabled.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Every leg rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, proved its marker in `dist/` with `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, restored to HEAD's blob (`git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, and proved the marker `--absent`:

<details><summary>ablation readings</summary>

- A, helper off (main's behaviour): `Failed Tests 40`. All 10 negative cases fail × 4, both CONTROLs stay green. One failure reads `expected [ 'null' ] to deeply equal [ 'com.qa.save_alpha' ]`.
- B, the row-only gap off: 12 failed (E ships with authored D row; unbound plus D row; two authored beside D).
- C, the read-judgment refusal names every row binding: 4 failed. One reads `expected '{"success":false,"error":{"code":"RES…' not to contain 'com.qa.save_authored_beta'`.
- D, the gap's two-holder refusal names every binding: 4 failed, same message.
- E, the unbound arm off: 4 failed. One reads `expected [ 'com.qa.save_alpha', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'com.qa.save_authored_beta', 'null' ]`.

</details>
